name: Apidae
coverage: Regional tourism information system used by tourist offices in several French regions, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes first among them
note: Built and tested on Apidae's own demonstration project. It goes live per office: the office creates an API project for DM2find and shares its key, we review a dry run together, and from the next night it enriches that office's DATAtourisme records.

name: Touripedia
coverage: Province of Groningen only — other Dutch destinations run on public sources

name: Open Data Germany
coverage: Nuremberg, Munich and Freiburg only — other German destinations run on public sources

name: Japanese local-government open data
attribution: Japanese local government open data (CC BY 4.0 / CC BY 2.1 JP), adapted by DM2find. Every record names its prefecture or city and dataset, e.g. Source: Kyoto Prefecture, 観光施設一覧 (CC BY 4.0), adapted by DM2find — in Japanese 出典：京都府「観光施設一覧」（CC BY 4.0）を加工して作成
coverage: Kyoto Prefecture, Osaka City (Map Navi Osaka) and 14 wards and cities of Tokyo — other Japanese destinations run on public sources
note: 21 local-government lists, matched against our existing Japanese records so nothing is added twice, and translated for visitors.

name: GeoFA (udinaturen.dk)
coverage: Outdoor facilities and routes maintained by Denmark’s municipalities: shelters, beaches, campsites, viewpoints, walking, cycling and riding routes
note: All of Denmark is imported and refreshed weekly — about 16,000 outdoor facilities and 5,800 routes, with Danish descriptions translated. It goes live with the first Danish destination.
